On Tue, Nov 2, 2026 at 09:07 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference> wrote:
> FYI - forwarding Hannah's note with confirmed QPS and preferred windows. Can you take a look and advise sizing + any infra runbook updates we need?

Thanks Marissa - sizing notes below. I also added a couple of operational caveats.

Sizing recommendation (initial):
- Model: finetuned-open-llama-13B (customer will run on Redwood Dedicated cluster)
- Sustained throughput target: 3,500 QPS (inferred as ~3,500 single-token generation requests/sec)
- Recommended capacity: 8 x A100-80GB (or equivalent H100 fleet with 4 x H100 if available) - this gives headroom for KV cache and batching overhead.
- Expected per-GPU steady throughput: ~450-500 QPS (dependent on prompt length / token output). We size for 450 QPS/GPU to be conservative.

Operational notes:
- Warmup: plan 15-30 minute gradual warmup to populate KV cache and stabilize batching behavior.
- Observability: we will enable token-level latency tracing and GPU-level metrics; please provide an SRE contact for FinTechCo to receive alerts during the run.
- Network: need CIDR allowlist (Hannah to share) and an SSH bastion for log collection if FinTechCo ops require it.
- Fallback: if dedicated capacity constrained, recommended fallback is hosted model variant "open-13b-lowmem" with rate-limiting; expect 2-3x higher latency but should avoid OOMs.

Runbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPloadtest (internal runbook, includes traffic replay commands and sample scripts)

If that sizing works I can provision a test cluster and share exact instance ids + a runbook checklist. Otherwise we can reduce to 6 A100s for a lower-cost, longer-duration run.
